title: Missing digit mysteries
goal: I can find missing digits in 3-digit sums. I can balance number sentences and solve magic squares and triangles.

learn.intro: A missing digit is a mystery to solve. Start at the ones column and ask: did I carry? The = sign means "is the same as".

example.problem: Find the missing digits in this sum.
steps: Ones: 5 + ? must end in 7. So the missing digit is 2.
Tens: ? + 4 must end in 1. 11 is possible: 7 + 4 = 11. Write 1 and carry 1.

howto.title: How to find a missing digit
steps: Move left, one column at a time.
Check by adding the whole numbers.

try.text: Find the missing digit.   5?4 + 337 = 891   The digit is {b}
try.explanation: Ones: 4 + 7 = 11, write 1 and carry 1. Tens: 5 + 3 + 1 = 9, so the missing digit is 5. Check: 554 + 337 = 891.

items.text: Find the missing digits. Each sum has 2. Write them in the answer boxes, top number first.
items.explanation: Work from the ones. (a) 4 + 9 = 13, so the bottom digit is 9 (carry 1). 4 + 5 + 1 = 10, so the top digit is 4. (b) 8 + 6 = 14 (carry 1). 4 + 2 + 1 = 7, so the top digit is 4. 4 + 4 = 8, so the bottom digit is 4. (c) 5 + 8 = 13 (carry 1). 6 + 3 + 1 = 10, so the bottom digit is 3. 4 + 2 + 1 = 7, so the top digit is 4.

items.text: Find the missing digits in these subtractions. Check each one by adding the answer to the number taken away. Write the digits top number first.
items.explanation: Turn each into an addition. (a) 568 + 267 = 835: 15, 13, 8 with carries. (b) 265 + 247 = 512: 12, 11, 5 with carries. So 835 - 267 = 568 and 512 - 247 = 265.

items.text: Both sides must have the same value. Fill in the boxes.
This is a magic square. Every row, column and corner-to-corner line has the same total.
Ali and Ben have 460 stickers altogether. Ali has 80 more than Ben.
items.explanation: Without the extra 80, both have the same, and together they have 380. Half of 380 is 190, so Ben has 190. Ali has 190 + 80 = 270. Check: 190 + 270 = 460.

items.text: Ben wrote 614 - 278 = 346. He checks by adding.
items.explanation: (a) 346 + 278 = 624. (b) A right answer would add back to 614, so Ben is wrong. (c) 614 - 278 = 336. Check: 336 + 278 = 614. Ben may have forgotten that the tens had lent 1 ten, so his tens digit is 1 too big.

items.text:
Ali had 345 stickers. He gave some away. Now he has 128 stickers.
(1) 345 + [ ] = 128      (2) 345 - [ ] = 128
(3) [ ] - 345 = 128      (4) 128 - [ ] = 345

parts.label: a
parts.text: Which number sentence matches the story?   {circ:(1)|(2)|(3)|(4)}

parts.label: b
parts.text: How many stickers did Ali give away? {b}

items.explanation: (a) He starts with 345 and takes some away, so 345 - [ ] = 128, which is (2). (b) 345 - 128 = 217. Check: 128 + 217 = 345.

items.text: Mei had 500 beads. She used some for a necklace and 135 for a bracelet. 210 beads were left. How many beads did she use for the necklace? {b}
items.explanation: Take away what she used and what was left: 500 - 135 - 210 = 155. Check: 155 + 135 + 210 = 500.

items.text: Add or subtract.
Make 1000. Fill in the missing number.
items.explanation: (a) 1000 - 340 = 660. (b) 1000 - 485 = 515. (c) 1000 - 755 = 245. (d) 1000 - 75 = 925. Tip: make the ones 10, the tens 9 and the hundreds 9 to reach 999, then add 1.

items.text: Lily's book has 500 pages. She has read 287 pages.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Then she reads 120 more pages. How many pages are left now? {b}

items.text: Fill the 6 circles with 120, 135, 150, 165, 180 and 195. Use each number once. Each side must add to 450.
items.explanation: 450: corners 120, 135, 150, and the sides are 195, 165 and 180. 495: the corners are the 3 greatest numbers 165, 180, 195, and the sides are 150, 120 and 135.
items.hint: Which numbers are used in 2 sides?

items.text: Circle True or False. Do not add both sides.
items.explanation: (a) True: 1 more and 1 less. (b) False: 10 more but 20 less, so 590 and 600. (c) True: 2 more and 2 less. (d) False: 550 and 560.
items.hint: Move the same amount from one number to the other.

items.text: Ali, Ben and Siti have 530 stickers altogether. Ali has 60 more than Ben. Siti has 40 fewer than Ben.
items.explanation: Ali has 60 more and Siti 40 fewer, so the 3 have 20 more than 3 Bens. 530 - 20 = 510, and 510 ÷ 3 = 170 for Ben. Ali 230, Siti 130. Check: 230 + 170 + 130 = 530.
items.hint: Make all 3 bars the same length as Ben's bar.

items.text: Ali and Mei have 540 stickers together. Mei and Ravi have 610 together. Ali and Ravi have 450 together. How many stickers does each child have?
items.explanation: 540 + 610 + 450 = 1600 counts each child twice, so all 3 have 800. Ravi 800 - 540 = 260. Ali 800 - 610 = 190. Mei 800 - 450 = 350.
items.hint: Add the 3 totals, then halve. That is all 3 children together.

items.text: Reverse a 3-digit number by swapping its first digit and last digit. Then take the smaller number from the greater.

parts.label: b
parts.text: What is the middle digit of both answers? {b}

items.explanation: (a) 742 - 247 = 495 and 831 - 138 = 693. (b) Both have 9 in the middle. (c) The answer is always a multiple of 99: 954 - 459 = 495 (5 × 99, and 9 - 4 = 5).
items.hint: Look at the middle digit. Add the digits of each answer.

items.text: Make your own missing-digit sum. Add two 3-digit numbers and hide 2 digits. Only ONE pair of digits may work. Many answers are right.

answer.text: Open. Example: 4?6 + 37? = 801 (426 + 375). Test every digit for each box: only 2 and 5 work.

items.explanation: Example: 426 + 375 = 801. Ones: 6 + ? must end in 1, so the ones box is 5. That carries 1. Tens: ? + 7 + 1 must end in 0, so the tens box is 2. Check that no other digit fits in each box.
items.hint: Start with a full sum. Then hide a digit in each number.

items.text: Mei adds 198 to her number. Ali takes 102 away from 900. They get the same answer.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Ravi adds 299 to his number. Siti takes 201 away from 1000. Same answer. Ravi's number is {b}

items.explanation: (a) Ali gets 900 - 102 = 798. Mei's number plus 198 is 798, so it is 798 - 198 = 600. (b) Siti gets 1000 - 201 = 799. Ravi's number is 799 - 299 = 500. Check: 500 + 299 = 799.
items.hint: Work out the answer Ali gets first.

items.text: Write the 2 missing digits.
items.explanation: Ones: 6 + 3 = 9, so the bottom box is 3. Tens: 5 + 3 = 8, so the top box is 5. Check: 256 + 433 = 689.

items.text: Ravi had 800 stickers. He gave 175 to Mei and some to Ben. 350 were left. How many did Ben get? {b}
Two numbers add up to 420. One is 60 more. What is the smaller number? {b}
items.explanation: Take away the extra 60: 420 - 60 = 360. Half of 360 is 180. The numbers are 180 and 240.
